title: Support Renewal Amount
content:
**Billing calculation note: SSL/TLS Certificates support renewal amount.** A support renewal is a renewal of an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription that Harborline support books for the customer during a conversation.

## The calculation

1. **Term.** A support renewal adds one year to the subscription. The year runs from the subscription end date, never from the payment date.
2. **List amount.** The list amount is the product's 1-year price plus the product's price per added name per year for each extra name recorded on the subscription. Both figures come from the product's price and name coverage schedules. The extra names are those recorded on the subscription at the time of the renewal.
3. **Renewal amount.** The support renewal amount is the list amount rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Fixed amounts.** Any fixed fee is added, and any fixed credit subtracted, only after the rounded amount is taken. The result is again rounded half up to the cent.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Certificate product | the subscription's product name (e.g. Harborline EV Multi-Domain) |
| 1-year price | the product's price schedule |
| Price per added name per year | the product's name coverage schedule (zero on products that offer no extra names) |
| Extra names | the count of extra names recorded on the subscription |
| Subscription end date | the subscription record; the renewed year starts on it |

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

The figures below are illustrative and are not product prices. Assume a multi-domain product with a 1-year price of USD 80.00 and a price per added name per year of USD 11.00. The subscription records 7 extra names and ends on 9 October 2032. The renewal is booked on 2 September 2032.

- List amount: USD 80.00 plus 7 names at USD 11.00, which is USD 157.00.
- Renewal amount: USD 157.00, which is already at the cent.
- Term: the subscription now ends on 9 October 2033, one year after the old end date and not one year after the payment on 2 September 2032.

On a single-name product the extra names part is zero, so the list amount is the 1-year price alone.
